Limit[n=20]
  Sort[keys=l.extended_price DESC]
    Project[l.id AS lineitem_id, o.id AS order_id, c.name AS cust_name, c.nation AS nation, l.extended_price AS extended_price]
      Filter[c.mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o.order_priority = '1-URGENT']
        Join[kind=inner, cond=o.cust_id = c.id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=l.order_id = o.id]
            Scan[lineitem]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[customer]
